      About Me

      Hello! I'm Wendayew, a full-stack developer and fourth-year Software Engineering student at Dire Dawa University in Dire Dawa, Ethiopia. I build reliable, maintainable applications from frontend client interfaces through backend services and database storage.

      My practical development experience centers around two real production platforms: architecting BuildBid Ethiopia (Construction Gebya) — an auction-based digital marketplace connecting contractors, suppliers, and transporters across Ethiopia — and engineering the 5-Star Hotel Management System for operational reservation workflows.

      I enjoy writing clean code, translating complex business processes into intuitive user flows, and working in collaborative software engineering teams.

      Education & Credentials:

      • B.Sc. in Software Engineering (Fourth Year) Dire Dawa University, Ethiopia · 2021 – Present
      • Languages Spoken Amharic (Fluent) · English (Working Proficiency)
      • Core Strengths Problem-Solving · Learning Agility · Practical Product Thinking
